_comment: Payload cheatsheets for parameter classes (ParameterClassifier) and injection-category findings (FindingTaxonomy). Passive reference only — ReconHub never sends these itself; they are shown in a read-only dialog and registered as Burp Intruder payload sets (registration only, no traffic). Tune/add freely.

sets.note: Swap this value with another user's/account's own ID (using a second authenticated session) to test authorization, not identity guessing.
Watch for the app following the value server-side (SSRF) or the browser redirecting (open redirect).
Path traversal / local file read candidates.
Quick manual probes; for a full boundary-driven scan see InjectScope.
OS command injection markers (look for timing/output changes).
Reflected-XSS breakout probes for a parameter already observed reflecting unencoded.
Confirm the app actually redirects to an attacker-controlled host.
